changes: The container runs on Node.js 24 and no longer as root. PUID and PGID set the user that owns uploads and backups.
The app refuses to start with a missing or example login secret. SESSION_SECRET is no longer needed.
Live updates during a metadata refresh only reach admins.
Tailwind, Font Awesome, Chart.js, the barcode scanner and all fonts ship with the app, so pages also look right without internet access.
Automated tests run before every image build.
Scheduled backups follow the TZ time zone.
The print view, statistics, web app manifest and login page use the colors of the active theme.
The dashboard always shows current data, and logging out always leads to the login page. A cached start page could show outdated data since 1.0.1.
The top list in the statistics shows each amount in its own currency.
The changelog can be opened in the settings.
Login right after the first-run setup works.
Admin actions show a clear success or error message, and a duplicate user is reported as an error.
"Delete last items" works again.
Titles and cassette numbers sort naturally.
Totals convert between currencies.
All pages, dialogs and print views follow your language, dates and numbers too.
The app starts and recovers on its own when the database is unavailable.
Scheduled backups catch up after downtime.
First tagged release with versioned Docker images.
First-run setup is locked once an admin exists, and old sessions end when the password changes.
Login throttling per client, and avatar uploads only accept real image files.
Hidden tapes, genres and types stay hidden on every page.
Editing a tape keeps its cast, and a second copy never overwrites the first.
A backup restore checks the file first, keeps a safety copy and rolls back on failure.
